watches.name: London Smoke
watches.description: Our first design the London Smoke is now available. Featuring a radiant deep grey dial and a unique engraving of London's skyline on the case back. Specifications: Case diameter: 40mm Lug to Lug: 47mm Case thickness: 11.7mm Case material: 316L Stainless Steel Movement: Japanese Miyota 8215 automatic and manual winding mechanical movement with "hacking" seconds. Power reserve ~40H accuracy -20+40 seconds a day. Glass: Sapphire Chrystal glass with anti reflective coating. Water resistance: 50m (suitable for every day water contact (rain, washing hands) not suitable for swimming.

watches.name: Maroon Fume Limited Edition
watches.description: Introducing the Fumé Limited Edition, a sophisticated evolution of the Mezei vision, strictly limited to just 50 pieces per colourway. This series marks a significant technical leap forward, featuring the premium Miyota 9015 automatic movement housed beneath a new sapphire crystal case back. Collectors can now admire the heartbeat of the watch and our signature custom-designed rotor. Each piece showcases our commitment to functional artistry, with the Maroon Fumé sporting a classic "Roulette" date wheel and the Midnight Fumé debuting a luminous date complication that alternates between deep blue and stealth black backgrounds every 24 hours. Crafted for those who appreciate rare, "sterile" dial aesthetics and precision, these 50-piece iterations are designed to become the cornerstone of any independent collection. By moving to the 9000-series caliber, we have ensured that the interior of the Mezei Fumé matches the mesmerizing depth of its textured sunray dial. Secure your position in this exclusive release now to avoid the waitlist; delivery for this limited batch is officially expected to begin in mid-April 2026. Case diameter: 40mm Lug to Lug: 47mm Case thickness: 11mm Case material: 316L Stainless Steel Movement: Japanese Miyota 9015 automatic and manual winding mechanical movement with "hacking" seconds. Power reserve ~42H accuracy -10+30 seconds a day. Glass: Sapphire Chrystal glass with anti reflective coating. Water resistance: 50m (suitable for every day water contact (rain, washing hands) not suitable for swimming.
